messages:
Alyssa M: Hey team — quick ask. I've had two dizzy spells this week (vertigo) and commuting + standing desks make it worse. Can we set up a temporary accommodation: fully remote for the next 3 weeks and an office loaner (chair + lumbar pillow) if I need to come in occasionally? Also want to flag my mentor handoff has been delayed and I don't want this to affect the performance cycle. @Kevin L can we sync on expectations?

Kevin L: Thanks for flagging, Alyssa. Sorry to hear that — health first. We won't treat this as a perf issue while it's being processed. Would you prefer to share a clinician note or have People Ops run the intake?

Alyssa M: I'll get a short note from my clinician by EOD. Prefer People Ops handle confidentiality. Also can we pause my weekend on-call for the duration? Nights trigger symptoms.

Sasha (People Ops): Hi Alyssa — we can definitely help. Please send the clinician note to people-ops@redwood.com or DM me directly and we'll open an ADA intake. For on-call coverage: we can propose a 3-week pause and coordinate reassignments. @Kevin L can you confirm coverage plan so we can document it?

Kevin L: I can reassign weekend on-call to Mira and reduce Alyssa's pager rotation. Draft plan: ```Week 1: Alyssa off weekends; Week 2–3: Alyssa on reduced nights (50% reduction) with Mira as backup and primary for escalations.``` If that works, I'll update schedule and notify the on-call rota.

Alyssa M: That plan works, thank you. Timeline: clinician note by EOD, remote start tomorrow, 3-week accommodation. Appreciate the quick response.

Sasha (People Ops): Logged. I'll create an accommodation record, send an accommodation agreement template (simple sign-off) and mark it confidential. We'll also kick off an equipment loaner request and note 'temporary reallocation of on-call duties' in the file.

HR Bot: Equipment request created: Item: Ergonomic lumbar pillow + office chair rental; ETA 5 business days. Ticket #EQ-4821

Alyssa M: Great — one more ask: can we do a short 30‑min manager + People Ops check-in at week 2 to make sure the accommodation is helping and align on any training/mentor handoff so things don't slip? Not a performance review, just alignment.

Kevin L: Scheduled a 30-min check-in for two weeks from now and added a note: 'operational coverage in place; no performance action related to accommodation at this time.'

Sasha (People Ops): Confirmed. We'll note: "temporary accommodation, no disciplinary actions connected to accommodation while active". If anything changes, DM me and we'll escalate to a private intake meeting.

Alyssa M: Thank you all so much :heart: Appreciate the support and confidentiality.
